Title: Freeze v21–v24 vocabulary, owner crates, and terminal horizon
Acceptance: All pack docs use one stable naming set and explicitly treat v24 as the terminal general-purpose spec horizon.
Required proof: Root docs + terminal design position + crate map.

Title: Add workspace-member plan for `effect-runtime`, `authority-delegation`, `assurance-runtime`, and `continuity-runtime`
Acceptance: The pack names the four owner crates and the exact workspace edits required.
Required proof: Workspace member snippet + exact file-touch map.

Title: Publish complete v21–v24 schema registry and per-wave manifests
Acceptance: Every wire-visible family has one owner, one schema filename, one example, and one per-wave manifest.
Required proof: Schema registry plan + 39 schema files + 39 examples + v21–v24 manifests.

Title: Freeze fixture corpus and reference-checker obligations for the final pass
Acceptance: The conformance plan names one happy path, one degraded path, and one replay/challenge path for each wave.
Required proof: Fixture corpus plan + fixture directories + kernel-conformance notes.

Title: Land `effect-runtime` owner crate and v21 entry artifacts
Acceptance: `EffectIntentV1`, `EffectWindowV1`, `EffectPreflightReportV1`, and `EffectCommitDecisionV1` exist as owned structs and schemas.
Required proof: Crate skeleton + schema files + serde tests.

Title: Prove one bounded preflight -> commit -> receipt -> observation slice
Acceptance: One live-effect path is replayable and observation-bearing.

Title: Prove blocked preflight and partial execution with typed compensation
Acceptance: Budget exhaustion or timeout produces explicit block/partial states and compensation objects.
Required proof: Blocked/prepartial fixture bundles + effect/release policy notes.

Title: Land `authority-delegation` owner crate and v22 entry artifacts
Acceptance: Capability, lease, delegation, authority-chain, and SoD objects exist as owned structs and schemas.
Required proof: Crate skeleton + schema files + serde tests.

Title: Prove one delegated effect path with dual control and acting-on-behalf receipt
Acceptance: One effect path can point to a valid authority chain and independent approvals.

Title: Prove revocation, conflict disclosure, and break-glass semantics
Acceptance: Expired or revoked leases fail explicitly; break-glass is bounded and post-hoc reviewable.

Title: Land `assurance-runtime` owner crate and v23 entry artifacts
Acceptance: Deployment, envelope, assurance, hazard, and release-decision objects exist as owned structs and schemas.
Required proof: Crate skeleton + schema files + serde tests.

Title: Prove one deployment profile with typed assurance case and release-readiness decision
Acceptance: One deployment path is not score-only and carries explicit monitors and gaps.

Title: Prove blocked release, residual-risk acceptance, and recertification triggers
Acceptance: Stale assurance degrades explicitly, residual risk is typed, and field triggers reopen the case.

Title: Land `continuity-runtime` owner crate and v24 entry artifacts
Acceptance: SLO, error budget, incident, containment, recovery, and postmortem objects exist as owned structs and schemas.
Required proof: Crate skeleton + schema files + serde tests.

Title: Prove one incident -> containment -> recovery -> postmortem path
Acceptance: One continuity path is replayable and evidence-preserving.

Title: Prove bounded continuity exceptions and error-budget-triggered containment
Acceptance: Emergency exceptions expire and budget exhaustion surfaces incident pressure explicitly.

Title: Wire stack-ids, schema generation, storage, runtime views, and adjudication snippets
Acceptance: The pack names the exact additive integration points across existing crates.
Required proof: Exact file-touch map + per-crate closeout plan + scaffolds.

Title: Freeze final-pass release bar and forbidden shortcuts
Acceptance: The release bar says what counts as landed and what remains profile-level or local-only.

Title: Validate pack completeness and manifest truth
Acceptance: Required docs exist; schema/example counts meet the bar; manifests and file lists agree.
Required proof: Pack truth script + manifest + file counts.
